events.title: Elixir 1.14 released
events.summary: The [Elixir] team released [Elixir] 1.14 on September 19, 2023 with improved error messages, `dbg/2` debugging, and compiler optimizations.
events.about: [Elixir] 1.14 made debugging and onboarding easier: `dbg` showed pipeline values inline; clearer compile errors reduced frustration for newcomers. Performance tweaks kept Phoenix and LiveView apps responsive under load.

narrative.whyChosen: [Elixir] 1.14 improved developer experience for the growing Phoenix/LiveView community.
narrative.whyImportant: Better errors and debugging tools lowered the barrier to [BEAM] adoption.
narrative.problemSolved: Opaque pipeline errors and cryptic compiler messages slowed [Elixir] onboarding.

events.title: Java 21 LTS released
events.summary: Oracle and the OpenJDK community shipped Java 21 on September 19, 2023 — an [LTS] release with virtual threads, sequenced collections, and pattern matching for switch.
events.about: Java 21's virtual threads (Project Loom) let servers handle millions of concurrent connections with simple thread-per-request code. As the current [LTS] after Java 17, it became the target for [Spring Boot] 3.2+, Gradle 8, and enterprise JDK upgrades through 2031.

narrative.whyChosen: Java 21 virtual threads were the biggest concurrency shift since Java 5 executors.
narrative.whyImportant: Loom made blocking-style code scale without reactive programming complexity.
narrative.problemSolved: Thread pools and reactive frameworks were the only ways to handle high concurrency at scale.

events.title: iPhone 15 released
events.summary: Apple released the iPhone 15 on September 22, 2023 — [USB]-C on all models and the A16/A17 Pro split across tiers.
events.about: [USB]-C ended the Lightning era for iPhone peripherals — one cable for iPad, Mac, and iPhone simplified hardware accessory development. The 15 Pro's A17 Pro emphasized console-grade mobile gaming.

narrative.whyChosen: The iPhone 15 switched the entire iPhone line to [USB]-C.
narrative.whyImportant: A universal [USB]-C port aligned iPhone with the rest of Apple's and Android's hardware ecosystem.
narrative.problemSolved: Developers and users juggled Lightning and [USB]-C cables across Apple devices.

events.title: Mistral 7B released
events.summary: Mistral AI released Mistral 7B on September 27, 2023 — a compact open-weight model outperforming larger LLaMA models on benchmarks.
events.about: Mistral 7B proved small, well-trained models could beat bigger ones — fueling edge deployment, local inference, and the European open-weights ecosystem. It established Mistral as a credible alternative to Meta and OpenAI for developers who wanted Apache-licensed weights.

narrative.whyChosen: Mistral 7B showed efficiency could beat raw parameter count.
narrative.whyImportant: Compact open models made LLMs runnable on consumer GPUs and laptops.
narrative.problemSolved: Teams needed capable models that did not require datacenter-scale [GPU] clusters.

events.title: EU designates Big Tech gatekeepers under Digital Markets Act
events.summary: The European Commission named six gatekeeper companies on September 6, 2023 under the Digital Markets Act — Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, ByteDance, Meta, and Microsoft — triggering interoperability and anti-self-preferencing obligations.
events.about: The DMA forced Apple to allow alternative app stores in the EU, required messaging interoperability discussions, and banned tying practices that locked users into platform defaults. Developers building on iOS, Android, and marketplaces gained new leverage — and new [compliance] work — as regulators worldwide copied the gatekeeper model.

narrative.whyChosen: DMA gatekeeper designations turned EU competition law into enforceable product requirements.
narrative.whyImportant: It mandated sideloading, choice screens, and data portability for the largest platforms.
narrative.problemSolved: Dominant platforms used default settings and walled gardens to block rival apps and services.
